The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 639fe69dbb6e6e93), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 17-18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Fix 0 < δ < 1/100, and put b = 1 8 , Kδ = s (1 + δ)3 1 − δ . Suppose that BN ∈ C∞(T; C), N ∈ N, satisfy BN (−t) = BN (t), and that their common modulus B = |BN | ∈ C∞(T) has the following properties. 1. 0 ≤ B ≤ Kδ, and B vanishes in neighborhoods of 0 and 1/2. The set E = {t ∈ [0, 1/2] : B(t) ≥ b} 17 is a nonempty finite union of disjoint closed intervals of positive length. The closures of its complementary intervals are Jj = [uj, vj], 1 ≤ j ≤ M, with lengths lj = vj − uj > 0, and 0 < L := M X j=1 lj ≤ 10δ. 2. At every endpoint z ∈ (0, 1/2) of a gap Jj, there are a neighborhood of z, a real number αz, and a real quadratic polynomial ψz, all independent of N, such that BN (t) = B(t)e αz + Nψz(t)  , xz := ψ′ z(z) ∈ (0, 1). There is an absolute constant D such that, for every sufficiently large integer N, there is a continuous function RN : T → C satisfying RN (−t) = RN (t), supported on the gaps and their reflections, for which b − o(1) ≤ |BN (t) + RN (t)| ≤ Kδ (t ∈ T), (43) max 0≤k<N √ N | b RN (k)| ≤ D √ δ, (44) X k∈Z\{0,...,N−1} | b RN (k)| = Oδ(N−1/4 ). (45) Every Fourier coefficient b RN (k) is real. The threshold for N and the constants implicit in o(1) and Oδ may depend on all the fixed input data; D does not.
